claim_boundary: Unproved composition candidates; zero score credit before exact constructive receipts.

subset_policy.retention_rule: A losing standalone slice may remain only when removal from the full composition causes reproducible net loss on development and sealed holdout after package and runtime accounting.

compositions.name: Wheeler Phase Tensor Retriever
compositions.fusion: Wheeler supplies exact prior-history continuations, changepoint state controls regime eligibility, and a tiny tensor train scores candidate-context interactions with protected base escape.
compositions.first_gate: Truth-aware exact-continuation ceiling, followed by frozen causal eight-subset shadow.
compositions.kill: Retire when causal ranking does not transfer, index speed is erased by scoring, or ABC loses to a proper subset after counted costs.

compositions.name: Selective Tensor State Replacement
compositions.fusion: Selective scalar channels and Householder reflections provide compact state, a tensor train provides nonlinear readout, and changepoint uncertainty modulates forgetting and resets.
compositions.first_gate: Frozen tensor and phase trace screen before reduced native N0/N1 replacement.
compositions.kill: Retire when state updates exceed removed cycles, tensor rank breaks packed economics, or phase modulation duplicates existing decay.

compositions.name: Orbit-Phase Parallel MDL Coder
compositions.fusion: A paid page model initializes parallel segments, soft changepoints select phase-conditioned contexts, and exact symmetry orbits share surface statistics while coding actions and residuals.
compositions.first_gate: Exact orbit oracle, then paid page-model accounting, then reduced serial N0 versus parallel N1.
compositions.kill: Retire when orbit savings do not repay model fields, segment redundancy dominates speed, or the full composition loses to a simpler subset.
